title: Dependency trim and version alignment (no new dependencies)
findings_note: app/build.gradle:51-61 (appcompat, material, compose material M2 unused; lifecycle 2.6.2 vs 2.8.2); app/build.gradle:1-5 (stale comment)
boundary: **Not in this slice:** adding any dependency, upgrading Kotlin or Compose, raising compile or target SDK (S48), R8 (S19) and signing (S47).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
- The dependency list carries artifacts the code does not use, which grows the APK and the F-Droid review surface: `appcompat`, `com.google.android.material` (only the XML theme parent used it, and S11 removes that), and Compose Material 2 (`androidx.compose.material:material`).
- (Lifecycle alignment and the version-catalog move were done in S53.)

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `app/build.gradle`
- `gradle/libs.versions.toml`
- `app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml`, `values-night/themes.xml` (read only: confirm S11 already removed the `MaterialComponents` parent)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - None. The build and unit tests are the check.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Record the baseline: `./gradlew :app:dependencies --configuration releaseRuntimeClasspath > before.txt` (keep it outside the repo or in the scratchpad), and note the debug APK size.
2. Confirm each removal candidate is unused: `rg -n "androidx.appcompat|com.google.android.material|androidx.compose.material\\." app/src`. The only acceptable hits are `androidx.compose.material.icons` (that is the icons library, which stays) and `androidx.compose.material3`. Also confirm no theme still uses `Theme.MaterialComponents`.
3. Remove `appcompat`, `com.google.android.material:material` and `androidx.compose.material:material` from `app/build.gradle`.
4. Remove the matching aliases from `gradle/libs.versions.toml` (S53 moved every dependency into the catalog, aligned lifecycle and deleted the stale comment, so none of that is needed here).
5. Run the baseline command again and compare.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug` passes.
- The app launches and every screen renders (including a dark-mode check).
- Record the dependency count and APK size before and after with `slicer note S46`.
